title: Q6: may an IO know which Spaces it serves?
description: RelayServiceAgreement names space CID + channel path globs and is gossiped in plaintext; messaging §6.2 has CO hand relay first-epoch access keys under the RSA. Result: relay can map token chains -> Space (not -> channel). ARCHITECTURE §5 budget doesn't list this. Options: (a) add 'identity of COs/Spaces it holds agreements with' to §5 as unavoidable business fact, forbid token->channel; (b) RSA references only opaque access-key chains, no space/channel identifiers, not gossiped. Raised in phase B review 2026-10-16.
close_reason: Option (b), Mark 2026-10-16: agreements signed by CO billing DID, name no Space/channel, private (not gossiped); coverage via AccessChainRegistration; IO learns CO not Space. ARCHITECTURE §5 item 6, §6.1, §9.
